blocks.text: All activities are subject to weather conditions. These may change the order of the tour, the activities planned and the total time spent on King George Island. The final decision on whether activities can be carried out rests with the Operations Department.
Ada Tours is not responsible for hotel breakfasts missed because of early check-out for an early flight or excursion.

blocks.text:
Upon arrival in Punta Arenas, the program includes 4 consecutive nights of accommodation with breakfast.

Reservations include double or twin rooms. For passengers travelling alone, a single room will be reserved.

Between 72 and 48 hours before the tour, you will receive instructions by email to participate in the Antarctic briefing meeting. There you will meet the other passengers and be welcomed by our host, who will offer a welcome cocktail.

Your arrival itinerary in Punta Arenas must allow you to attend the briefing. Passengers who are not present at this meeting will not be able to participate in the booked tour.
